title: stuck or trapped
content: I have dreamed of "mallword" my entire life...its mostly these dreams that I remeber having. I just fou d this sub last night and I'm SHOOK. My mind just cant relax about all this. I've never looked into these dreams, but last week I had two back to back dreams in mallworld and like all the others, I feel I'm trying to escape or find something. I often find myself finding new hallways, or gaps between shops that I take and they may dead end or lead ih into bigger empty rooms. The difference into these two dreams was that in each one, I would find a gap like before, but I would become stuck. Like when ppl get stuck between cave walls while spelunking. I couldn't move out of the gaps and I started to panic and felt squished and found it hard to breath. I've NEVER gotten stuck before. After the second time I woke up crying. These led me into finally taking a look into if other people had similar dreams and then I find this sub. Have any of you ever got trapped or stuck in the randome spots? Side question: I fell into the rabbit hole of disneys original plans for epcot...and it seems like my mallword...I've only seen one other post suggesting epcot. Any thoughts?
